tasks.short: Maintain detailed care-plan and prognosis records

steps.what: Gather and verify current patients' health care plans and prognoses
Draft complete and detailed care-plan and prognosis record text

loop.purpose: Turn practitioner-verified notes into a fixed-template record without new clinical conclusions
loop.input: Verified documentation notes with patient and encounter identity, explicit plan, prognosis and uncertainty
loop.output: Draft care record with each statement linked to its source note
loop.check: Practitioner checks meaning, negation, chronology, plan details, prognosis qualifiers, missing facts and any unsupported assertion against source notes
loop.stop: One draft and at most one requested revision; missing or conflicting facts stop drafting and return to manual completion; no automatic save
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured fields use native mapping, but converting variable clinician prose into coherent narrative requires language interpretation; native templates are tested first

steps.what: Validate the complete record and save the exact checked version

tasks.design: Use native templates in the clinical record {OTHER} for fixed fields, adding a bounded narrative draft only where verified notes need rewriting. The practitioner supplies the clinical facts and checks the exact final record; neither prognosis nor treatment is generated by the drafting tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current facts and decisions must be rewritten into detailed narrative fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical drafting capabilities show that reviewed narrative drafts are possible, while fixed fields can stay deterministic.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving uncertainty, chronology and exact care decisions without omissions or invented certainty.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner knows the clinical context, can detect a misleading summary and takes responsibility for corrections.
tasks.altitude: Less narrative rewriting; clinical judgement and record accountability remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review source traceability and correction handling in a care record
reach.learn: Clinical provenance and limits of non-clinical record review

evidence.claim: Autoscriber records consultations and produces notes validated by clinicians before entry into clinical records; this supports reviewed drafting capability rather than autonomous care planning.
The Capio study reported self-estimated note time falling from 6.69 to 4.72 minutes while median editing remained 93 seconds; it does not establish this role's total task saving.
Drafting a record from practitioner-verified notes with the proposed allocations is an unmeasured implementation scenario.

assumptions: Boundary begins after care-plan and prognosis decisions and ends at the saved record; diagnostic and treatment reasoning are separate tasks.

Practitioner in s1 verifies and captures patient ID, encounter date, source references, current plan actions, responsible clinician, follow-up, explicit prognosis, qualifiers and unknowns. Full 25 hours include all source capture; no ready transcript or free external feed is assumed.

S2 uses those notes only. Fixed fields map natively, narrative assertions retain source references, and absent prognosis remains absent rather than inferred. Retained 20.25 hours cover draft correction and manual fallback.
S3 retains full final meaning, identity and completeness checks. Any edit after approval requires another check; no unsigned output becomes a clinical fact.

Test native configuration before a model loop. Determine intended-use device obligations, access, processing basis and applicable employee consultation before deployment; no public chatbot receives patient data.
Record capture shared with other documentation tasks must be assigned once in a roll-up; no double claim for the same entry.
unknowns: Native approved drafting and record interfaces
Local device assessment, access and consultation requirements
research_questions: Does a trial preserve prognosis qualifiers and care actions while reducing rewriting after full correction and final review time?

already_counted.description: Clinical-source verification and exact note capture
Draft correction, exceptions and manual fallback
Final clinical meaning, completeness and save check

incremental.description: Audit omissions, test updates, maintain templates and resolve access exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient and encounter record with source-linked plan, follow-up, prognosis, qualifiers and corrections; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=25+20.25+30=75.25; gross 24.75 less 4 upkeep gives central net 20.75. High requires substantial narrative rewriting. Low assumes only 4 hours removed because corrections are frequent, consumed by upkeep. Clinical fact capture and final review retain all time; the cited case is not this estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop treatment plans from evidence and practice guidelines

steps.what: Locate and assess scientific rationale, standards of care and practice guidelines
Develop treatment plans from patient context and checked guidance

tasks.design: Configure a versioned guideline index in {DOCS} with direct source passages. The practitioner checks applicability and develops the treatment plan using patient context in the clinical record {OTHER}; the index neither recommends a plan nor issues orders.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current guidelines and their relevant sections must be located across reference sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search, bookmarks and source-version metadata can shorten retrieval without clinical inference.
tasks.still_hard: Applying evidence to comorbidities, preferences, uncertainty and local professional scope.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner can explain trade-offs and choose a justified departure from general guidance.
tasks.altitude: Less reference hunting; treatment decisions and patient discussion retain their time.

reach.task: Locate the source guideline behind a stated care-plan instruction
reach.learn: Version checking and when applicability needs practitioner review

evidence.claim: A native versioned guideline index can shorten locating references while leaving clinical applicability and treatment planning to the practitioner; the allocation is modelled.

assumptions: Boundary is guideline-informed planning, excluding record drafting, prescribing and order release.

Practitioner formulates the search question and checks source title, issuer, version, date, section and applicability in retained s1 time. Its 17.5 hours include query creation and source verification; no structured diagnosis or suitability label is assumed.
Existing authorised guidelines remain the source; links never become automatic care instructions. Missing or stale references require manual retrieval within retained time.
Test native search and bookmarks before custom code; existing search capability earns no incremental saving. Index maintenance is counted as upkeep.
Local practitioner scope governs treatment authority; the occupational statement does not extend it.
unknowns: Current retrieval burden and guideline access
research_questions: Can a source index reduce retrieval without reducing applicability checks or missing updated guidance?

already_counted.description: Question formulation, applicability and source verification

incremental.description: Maintain guideline versions and broken references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=17.5+75=92.5 give gross 7.5, less 2 upkeep gives net 5.5. High requires scattered references; low assumes only 2 hours of retrieval removed, consumed by upkeep. Clinical planning and discussion retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide patient information for health promotion and prevention

steps.what: Clarify patients' information needs, risk concerns and understanding
Locate and check information to promote health and prevent disease
Provide patients with information and check their understanding

tasks.design: Configure topic and language filters over vetted patient information in {DOCS}. The practitioner selects and checks the source material, explains it and checks understanding; no autonomous patient-specific answer is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right current patient-information passage takes repeated searching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filters and maintained references can shorten retrieval without changing clinical advice.
tasks.still_hard: Making information meaningful to the person's circumstances, literacy and readiness to act.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner can notice misunderstanding and explain the same point differently.
tasks.altitude: Less material hunting; patient contact and advice responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Find the checked patient-information source supporting an agreed education topic
reach.learn: Source currency and boundaries of personal advice

evidence.claim: Thuisarts provides guideline-based patient information from Dutch professional and patient organisations; this establishes a vetted reference source, not measured retrieval savings.
Native topic and language filters can reduce reference hunting while retaining suitability checks; the time estimate is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is patient education, excluding diagnosis, treatment selection and later record maintenance.

Practitioner clarifies needs in s1 and selects topic, intended language, reading format, source passage and version in retained s2. Its 12 hours include all selection, field capture and applicability checks.
No structured risk code, inferred literacy score or new patient questionnaire is assumed. Missing suitable material returns to manual source retrieval and explanation.
Test native filters before custom code; current reference search earns no new saving. All patient discussion and understanding checks retain their time.
unknowns: Current retrieval effort and approved materials
research_questions: Can a filtered reference view shorten locating suitable material while preserving patient understanding?

already_counted.description: Material selection, applicability and current source checks

incremental.description: Maintain source links, topic tags and language availability

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=20+12+60=92 give gross 8, less 2 upkeep yields net 6. High assumes repeated source hunting; low assumes only 2 hours removed in an already organised library, consumed by upkeep. Patient contact retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret clinical information to develop diagnoses

steps.what: Analyze patients' histories, symptoms, physical findings and diagnostic information
Develop appropriate diagnoses and decide what further assessment is needed

tasks.design: Keep clinical interpretation and diagnosis with the practitioner using the clinical record {OTHER}. This design does not introduce a general diagnostic model, infer missing findings or transfer specialty image evidence into an unrelated diagnosis claim.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diagnosis requires weighing incomplete or conflicting evidence in the individual patient's context.
tasks.enabler_now: Documentation capabilities do not establish a safe replacement for this diagnostic reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: Testing alternatives, recognising uncertainty and knowing when specialist assessment is required.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner can question an apparent pattern, seek new evidence and explain uncertainty to the patient.
tasks.altitude: No change to diagnostic time or local clinical scope.

reach.task: Review an uncertain diagnostic assessment through existing referral arrangements
reach.learn: Clear differential reasoning and referral boundaries

evidence.claim: Patient-specific diagnostic reasoning remains professional judgement; documentation tools alone establish no diagnostic labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is interpretation and diagnosis, not source measurement, note drafting or test-order entry. Existing findings are inputs from the normal clinical workflow.
Practitioner produces interpreted evidence in s1 before the assessment in s2. No structured diagnostic conclusion, complete history feed or automatic missing-data inference is assumed.
Local qualification and scope determine authority; this design grants no additional diagnostic rights.
Review native record access before future custom work. No new software or maintained process is introduced, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Local practitioner scope and specialist referral routes
research_questions: Which uncertainties require more evidence or referral rather than faster record presentation?

already_counted.description: Diagnostic reasoning and further assessment decisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give zero saving. Routine and uncertain diagnostic assessments retain interpretation and reasoning time; note-writing gains belong to the record task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce record rewriting and reference hunting while retaining patient dialogue, treatment judgement and diagnosis.
reach: Help records specialists audit source traceability and nurses locate checked patient guidance
role.ambitious_version: A practitioner who can give patients attention and explain clinical decisions while maintaining checked records and traceable sources.
